_doc: Keys integrated through a customer-side proxy URL. 'skip' lists the CDN-level fields that describe the customer's proxy, not the visitor: ja4 (TLS/JA4 checks, UA vs JA4), http_version (HTTP/3 / HTTP/1.1 checks), header_order (cdn-header-order-* / susp-rfc-violation-* header flags - do not draft TTs on them). Judge these keys on client-side fingerprint fields. Verified per key from one day of JA4 / HTTP-version profile (2026-11-24).

F5675B21-025B-4843-983C-38D86DEB394B.name: Pinterest - Login - Production - Key 1
F5675B21-025B-4843-983C-38D86DEB394B.note: Pinterest proxy URL integration. Up to the week of 2026-10-19 Login/Registration had 1-3 JA4s and 1-3 JA3s (the proxy's). From the week of 2026-10-26 they carry hundreds of JA4s and ~all-distinct JA3s (real Chrome-style GREASE/extension shuffling): Pinterest now forwards the visitor's TLS fingerprint. JA4 usable from 2026-10-26 (not before); its transport letter is not (QUIC clients show as t..h3). CDN HTTP version is the proxy leg (1.1 on 100%) and header order is the proxy's.
